about: A fictional copy of Patrick's own diagram: the same generations, links, event kinds, dates, date certainties and shifts on the same people, every name, place, job and wording changed. Owen is the person. His answer to when the most was going on gives ages, not years, as Patrick's did.
draft: ACCEPTED PROVISIONALLY: the expected clusters below stand as drafted until Patrick points out a cluster detection problem (R-0857, builds on R-0856); of the four open questions, question 2's second half (the late-2025 to October 2026 run around his wife's family weekend) is answered: not a cluster (Patrick, 2026-10-14: "2025 2026 doesn't need to be a cluster."); the rest stay open.

said.question: Looking back over your life so far, what were the two or three times when the most was going on, and about what years were they?
said.words: Two or three times stand out, and the first is my launch. Leaving for college the first time was stressful all round: Highland College and the rowing were intense, then I got injured out of it, came home and skipped school for about a semester, then went to the city college, which was a dark stretch with a lot of drinking with the exchange students. Things turned around when I went to Denmark and then Edinburgh and finished my degree fast, with a lot of drive. After that it was mostly high energy outdoor stuff, going back and forth to Pine Ridge, until things got hard at home in my late 20s. I moved to Pine Ridge, more or less cut off from a lot of friends, and my relationships were in poor shape generally. Six months later I moved to Lake Corran to be with Ines, which didn't last, and then came the major depression we've talked about, and the long slow climb back to functioning, which was mostly done when I came home after grad school. My hunch is that something came before each of those two hard stretches. I'm also curious when my sleep trouble started, being so wound up, maybe chronic anxiety or something close to manic, I don't know. I wonder about roughly eight to ten into early high school and what it did to my development. Before that is hard to see, I was so young.
